title: Preparing Traditional Japanese New Year Food — Osechi Ryōri Vlog / 伝統的な日本の正月料理の準備
description: A vlog-style walkthrough of preparing osechi-ryōri (お節料理), the traditional multi-tiered boxed meal served at Japanese New Year. The creator explains the cultural significance and symbolism of each component — from 黒豆 (black beans for health) to 数の子 (herring roe for fertility) to 伊達巻 (sweet rolled omelet for knowledge). Filmed in a home kitchen with natural Japanese narration describing preparation methods and the meaning behind each dish.
creator: Japanese cooking vlogger
